task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then get the USD to JPY exchange rate, and use that to show me Apple’s stock price in JPY. After that, create a weekly checking account balance report for user_001 in JPY and send it as a medium-priority app notification, then also get me the current price of BTC.

Also, please get me the current price of BTC.
